holdout: Domestic holdout: Eredivisie, Primeira Liga and Super Lig, 16 Jan - 10 Oct 2026 (646 matches, 25 weeks), Bet365 pre-match prices with the margin removed; evaluation_harness.py --declaration, recorded in evaluation/holdout_ledger.json
candidate_definition: D_pow2 exactly as built in PR #184 (plan Phase 3b-2), registered as harness candidate D_pow2 (evaluation_harness.CAGEY_CANDIDATES): the market grid fitted to power-method targets (1X2, totals and the main AH line, each with the margin removed by the power method), corrected toward narrow margins by D_pow's correction (cagey-correction-through-2425-power-v1's coefficients, fitted on that grid), then the 1X2 set separately from the power quote by rule power-quote-draw-uplift-v1 with a = +0.029140 and b = -0.060942 as fitted on the correction's own 10,956 training rows (closing prices, 6 Aug 2021 - 1 Jun 2025). Model file narrow_margin_models/candidates/cagey-correction-through-2425-power-1x2-v1.json, content digest 82cf7306eee5bdfda21c4fb37d367e6e8b1bf9171415f5acacc3f4827b7123af; nothing refitted on later data. The baseline D is the live cagey grid (proportional margin removal, production correction cagey-correction-through-2425-v1).
pass_rule: D_pow2 passes only if all three hold on the holdout. (1) Sample minimum: 300 fixtures and 6 weeks, counted on the holdout fixtures where D_pow2 and D are both scored on AH lines. (2) The cagey events rule cagey-events-v1 passes for D_pow2: on the rule's own events (side chosen by D's expected return, synthetic prices from M plus Bet365's average AH margin, exactly the events D was judged on), both families, (a) P(|margin| <= 1) and (b) P(no loss) on the AH lines the cagey tier can bet (-3.00 to +3.00, odds window (1.15, 2.00], one side per fixture, one event per floor(line) family), each with D_pow2's slope in 0.90-1.10 or closer to 1 than M's on the same events, and no band of at least 30 events more than 5 points off AND Bonferroni-clear. (3) Point estimates: D minus D_pow2 log loss on AH all lines and on the draw-sensitive lines (-0.5, 0, +0.5) are both not negative (zero or above). The week-resampled 95% intervals are reported and do not decide (holdout_verdict.passes_holdout_gate).

outcomes.release: All three conditions of the pass rule hold: release D_pow2 as the cagey correction.
outcomes.no_release: Otherwise (the events rule fails in either family, or either point estimate is negative, or the sample minimum is not met): no release. Nothing live changes; the report is saved; no shadow run.

events_reading: Two points fixed here before scoring. (1) The rule is judged against M, as cagey-events-v1 is defined and as it was applied to D_pow2 on development and validation (plan 3b-2, choice rule 1); D's own check on the same events is reported as context and does not decide. (2) The no-loss family is the configured rule's: every bettable line from -3.00 to +3.00, not plus lines only (in D's holdout run 1,286 of the 1,388 no-loss events were level or plus-line families and 102 minus-line families). A declaration can only name a configured rule; a plus-lines-only family would be a new rule and a config change first. Events on which D_pow2 has no forecast (its power grid could not be fitted) are left out for D_pow2, D and M alike.
bet365_note: The holdout's market grid is built from Bet365 quotes (Pinnacle prices in the files stop on 15 Jan 2026), so here the power method and the 1X2 rule are applied to Bet365's quote, whose 1X2 margin is larger (5.8% against Pinnacle's 3.7% on matches priced by both). The live cagey tier is priced from Pinnacle. The result is therefore a safety check that the candidate does no harm on unseen matches, not a measure of the live effect.
known_before_scoring: D's holdout result against M (scored once on 12 Nov 2026: slopes D / M 1.148 / 1.194 on P(narrow) and 1.138 / 1.149 on P(no loss), no band failing; AH all M minus D +0.00136, -0.00023 to +0.00304), so M's slopes, the bar D_pow2's slopes are judged against, are known in advance. D_pow2 on development (D minus D_pow2 AH all +0.00098, +0.00043 to +0.00146; in-sample) and validation (+0.00123, +0.00003 to +0.00244), where it passes cagey-events-v1 in both. Nothing of D_pow2 on the holdout.
setup: Decided by Paul on 17 Nov 2026 (plan 3b-2, Decision; confirmed in Prompt 5): D_pow2 is the cagey candidate, declared once against D; a and b stay as fitted; D_pow is not declared. The deciding criterion calibration_and_point_estimates was added to the harness under its own name by this PR, before this declaration was scored. A plain harness run is byte-identical with D_pow2 registered. Nothing is tuned on the holdout. The ledger holds C6 (candidate, 11 Nov 2026) and D (candidate, 12 Nov 2026); D_pow2 has not been scored.
declared_by: Paul (decision, 17 Nov 2026), written by Claude Code
notes: Scored once with evaluation_harness.py --declaration. No rerun, no change to the setup after it. The holdout decides: there is no forward waiting and no live shadow period before a release. A release still needs the parity test, the replay over the saved live forecasts and a reviewed PR, and the released correction must be the one fitted on the candidate's own grid. European forecasts (the flagged cagey correction on UCL/UEL) stay as they are.
